name: table
gotchas: MatTableDataSource re-renders only when you reassign its `.data` property (or push through the `data` setter) — mutating the underlying array in place will not update the table.
Every string in `displayedColumns` must exactly match a `matColumnDef` name, in the order you want columns rendered — a mismatch silently drops the column instead of throwing.
For large or frequently-changing row sets, provide a `trackBy` on `*matRowDef`/`*matHeaderRowDef` to avoid full DOM re-renders when only a subset of rows change.
